name: A Tanka boat, Macau, with a lift net lowered into the water
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a Tanka boat with a seated figure, Macau; a lift net, suspended from a pole which is attached to a vertical stake at the stern of the boat, has been lowered into the water. For a comparable drawing see E.1639-1928.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
